description: This file defines the ImageProcessorFactory class and related functions for creating image processors with various backends (VAAPI, V4L2, LibYUV, GL) for media processing on ChromeOS, including handling input candidates, supported formats, and platform-specific optimizations.

classes.name: ImageProcessorFactory
classes.description: Factory class providing static methods to create various image processors with different backends and configurations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an ImageProcessor with specified input/output configurations, selecting from available backends.

methods.name: CreateWithInputCandidates
methods.description: Creates an ImageProcessor based on input candidates and format preferences, attempting to use hardware or software backends.

methods.name: CreateLibYUVImageProcessorWithInputCandidatesForTesting
methods.description: Creates a LibYUV-based ImageProcessor for testing purposes with specified input candidates.

methods.name: CreateGLImageProcessorWithInputCandidatesForTesting
methods.description: Creates a GL-based ImageProcessor for testing purposes with specified input candidates.
